epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce full stack startup and verification time from >10 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root that starts the full stack
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for verification

slices.title: Add docker-compose for full stack deployment
slices.jtbd: When implementing the docker-compose setup for this epic, I want to configure the full stack containers, so that the product can be launched and verified locally.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local checkout of the repository,
When docker-compose up is executed,
Then all backend and frontend services start successfully.
Given the running stack,
When the health-check endpoint is queried,
Then it returns a successful HTTP 200 status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce manual container startup configuration errors from >1 per day to 0

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to update or delete a material from >5 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add UI capability to update an existing material via PUT endpoint
R2: Add UI capability to delete an existing material via DELETE endpoint

slices.title: Implement update and delete material UI patches
slices.jtbd: When implementing the update and delete material UI patches for this epic, I want to connect the frontend to the existing PUT and DELETE endpoints, so that the catalog accurately reflects the most current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system,
When a user chooses to edit it from the UI,
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT API endpoint and the catalog is updated.
Given an existing material in the system,
When a user chooses to delete it from the UI,
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding DELETE API endpoint and the catalog is updated.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce frontend API PUT/DELETE integration latency from manual to <500ms

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0
requirements: R1: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in when accessing the catalog
R2: Block unauthenticated users from creating materials

slices.title: Implement authentication and route protection
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to protect the catalog and creation routes, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user,
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material,
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given an authenticated user,
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material,
Then they are granted access successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthenticated request penetration to protected routes from 100% to 0%
